kicker: Work with me · Independent travel consultant
heading: Latin America, beyond the beaten track.
lead: A partner on the ground for travel agencies: I help you develop Latin America into a reliable and distinctive part of your portfolio, from the first idea to the group in the field.
heroAlt: Colonial arches in Antigua, Guatemala, with a volcano behind

services.title: Design the trip
services.text: Routes, pace and experiences, shaped into an itinerary that suits your travellers.

services.title: Coordinate on the ground
services.text: Accommodation, transport, guides and local suppliers — arranged in Spanish, within your procedures.

services.title: Lead the group
services.text: In the field with your travellers, day to day, solving what the road always brings.

servicesNote: Pick one, or the whole journey from first idea to the field.
whyHeading: Knowledge from the road, not from a catalogue.

reasons.title: Three years in the field
reasons.text: Local buses, border crossings, night roads and family guesthouses — known first-hand.

reasons.title: Spanish without intermediaries
reasons.text: Direct conversations with local partners, so nothing is lost in translation.

reasons.title: One person, start to finish
reasons.text: The one who designs the programme also leads it, so no knowledge is lost between stages.

reasons.title: Your brand stays yours
reasons.text: Trips run under your licence, contracts and name. I work as your external specialist.

places: Guatemala · Peru · Bolivia · Colombia · Argentina · Chile · Uruguay · Brazil

steps.title: A conversation
steps.text: Tell me about your travellers and what you'd like to offer.

steps.title: A first proposal
steps.text: I sketch a route and a programme, with what it needs on the ground.

steps.title: On the ground
steps.text: We refine it together, and I coordinate or lead it in the field.

about: For almost three years I have travelled independently across the Americas, by local buses, trucks, boats, trains and on foot. I write about it on Resplandor, my travel journal, and I want to help agencies build Latin American programmes that are authentic, but also workable.
note: I do not act as a tour operator: trips are delivered under the agency's own licence and procedures.
